title: Kuusi Default Openers
description: Choose which file types open with Kuusi by default in the file browser.

useKuusiForNotebook.title: Notebooks (.ipynb)
useKuusiForNotebook.description: Enable Kuusi View for notebooks (Article / Mind Map from the toolbar).

useKuusiForMarkdown.title: Markdown (.md)
useKuusiForMarkdown.description: Enable Kuusi View for Markdown (Article / Slides / Mind Map from the toolbar).

enabledViews.title: Enabled views
enabledViews.description: Views shown in the view menu. Article, Book and Slides are off by default (still in testing); turn them on here.

viewOrder.title: View button order
viewOrder.description: Left-to-right order of the Article / Book / Mind Map / Slides buttons in the view menu. The first one opens by default.
